gap: BHD is clean (0 of 5,184,000 desktop px and 0 of 1,316,640 mobile px differ with the wave stylesheet present vs removed, bbox None), so nothing leaks. Ours loses on design. Desktop is a real gain over BHD's grey 'No Data Found' glyph: a soft tile, a 'No matches' heading and a two-line recovery sentence, column headers retained. But it ships three artifacts the Wave bar never shows: the sticky-column shadow now renders as a hard grey gradient smear that steps abruptly to the right of 'Payment' and leaves the header band ending ragged short of the card's rounded corner; the first toolbar control's search button box sits ~6px higher than the input it abuts, its magnifier clipped under a stacked clear-x; and ~120px of unexplained blank card sits below the empty block inside an ~830px card holding one sentence, while the KPI strip 300px above still asserts 5/10, 3/10, 2/10 against a table that says no invoices match. Mobile 390x844 fails outright: the toolbar wraps into a five-row staircase of mismatched control widths, then ~250px of blank white card, and the empty state itself lands below the fold, the icon tile sliced in half by the bottom nav, heading and copy never visible. Wave's frame is unbroken, single-rhythm and fully legible at the size shown; ours is not, so it does not clearly win.
